Question
========
What are countervailing powers in Galbraith's sense?

Answerlist
----------
* Trade unions, cooperatives, small retailers, and public regulation that balance corporate power
* Large corporations that compete with each other
* Central banks that set interest rates
* International organisations such as the IMF

Solution
========
Galbraith argued capitalism works acceptably only when counterweights balance the power of large corporations.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
